plans.idea: Mirror the original: headline and subline flush-left over a wide column so the headline sets large on one line, with the book cover anchored at the far right edge where the tan circle sits behind it, so it reads left to right from message to product.

Book cover pinned flush to the left margin as a brand anchor, then the text block starts right after a tight gutter and runs across almost the whole remaining width, so there is no dead space on the left like the current engine output.
Text and book kept together as one left-weighted group (copy, then the cover right next to it), leaving the right end open for the decorative circle so the banner ends on a calm accent.
